title: Convexity conjecture for the pendulum time map
statement: Let $T_B(z,\phi)$ be the time map defined in the paper for parameters $z$ and $\phi$, with $z\in(0,2)$ and $\phi\in(0,\frac{\pi}{2})$. **Convexity conjecture.** For each $\phi\in(0,\frac{\pi}{2})$, the function $z\mapsto T_B(z,\phi)$ is convex. The authors report convincing numerical evidence for the positivity of the quantity governing the second derivative, but were unable to prove it; establishing this convexity would yield the existence of a single minimum of the time-map graph.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.13009

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2019).
source_name: Fernando P. da Costa, Michael Grinfeld, João T. Pinto and Kedtysack Xayxanadasy, “Bifurcating solutions in a non-homogeneous boundary value problem for a nonlinear pendulum equation”, arXiv:1907.13009 (2019).
